## MathLib.mulDiv() function

Multiplies two numbers and divides by a denominator with a rounding direction.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function mulDiv(x: BigIntish, y: BigIntish, denominator: BigIntish, rounding: RoundingDirection): bigint;
```
